dropdown.triggeredBody: The inline panels above are always visible and render as a plain group. For a real popup menu — trigger button, positioning, dismissal, typeahead, and close-on-select, built on Base UI's Menu — compose DropdownMenu, DropdownTrigger, and DropdownContent. Any element can be the trigger via the render prop.
dropdown.p0: Index of the currently checked item.
dropdown.p2: Accessible name for the inline panel. The always-visible panel renders as a plain group; popup menu semantics belong to the triggered DropdownContent.
dropdown.m3: Called when the menu opens or closes.
dropdown.t0: Element to render as the trigger, for example a Button.
dropdown.t1: Trigger content when no render element is given.
dropdown.c1: Index of the checked item; drives the animated selected background and radio-group value.
dropdown.c2: Preferred side of the trigger to place the popup.
dropdown.c4: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.
dropdown.i0: Icon displayed in the menu item.
dropdown.i1: Text label for the menu item.
dropdown.i3: Whether this item is checked. When set, the item is a radio-style option; otherwise it is a plain action item.
dropdown.i4: Called when this item is selected.
dropdown.i6: Popup-only: whether selecting the item closes the menu. Ignored in the inline panel.
